description: You are an Architectural Drafter at a structural steel fabrication company. Design a steel gusset plate connection bracket in FreeCAD for connecting a diagonal HSS brace to a W8x31 wide-flange column. The gusset plate must incorporate the following design requirements based on AISC standard connection design practice: (1) Main plate body: approximately 250mm wide x 200mm tall x 12mm thick structural plate. (2) Brace bolt group: 4 bolt holes arranged in a 2-row x 2-column pattern (70mm gauge width, 75mm row pitch) for M20 bolts (22mm clearance holes) positioned in the upper-left quadrant of the plate for brace attachment. (3) Column bolt group: 4 bolt holes also for M20 bolts (22mm clearance holes) in a 2x2 pattern (70mm gauge, 75mm pitch) positioned along the left edge for column flange attachment. (4) Weld preparation: a chamfered edge (45-degree chamfer, 6mm depth) along the brace attachment edge (top edge) for field welding. (5) A Spreadsheet listing the plate width, height, thickness, bolt diameter, and gauge as named parameters, functioning as a basic Bill of Materials table. Log in as ga / password123. Export the finished plate to STEP format at /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/gusset_plate.step for the steel fabrication shop, and save the FreeCAD model to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/gusset_plate.FCStd.
